visual_anatomy.title: A two-line how-to title reserves lavender rough-lettered capsules for the two operative phrases and leaves the surrounding wording in oversized sans.
visual_anatomy.layout: A vertical four-step instruction rail runs down the left; a large nested elliptical object on the right is the visual result being constructed.
visual_anatomy.reading_order: Title → first instruction → downward arrows through the four instruction cards → corresponding layered object at right.
visual_anatomy.typography: Oversized sans title, rough marker-like accent tags, bold multi-line instruction cards, and sparse directional arrows.
visual_anatomy.colour: Lavender unifies the instruction cards; the right-side object builds through nested lavender, blue, aqua, and pink layers against white.
visual_anatomy.surface: White ground, dark hand-drawn-like outlines, rounded step cards with soft depth shadow, and simple pseudo-3D cylinders/ellipses.
visual_anatomy.modules: Four sequential instruction cards and one four-layer construct that can appear either as flat nested rings or raised stacked cylinders.
visual_anatomy.density: Low-medium: generous whitespace keeps the object transformation and the four-step route easy to follow.

motion.observed_state_change: The opening sample shows the result as flat nested ellipses; the material-intermediate sample raises those layers into a stepped stack while later instruction cards fade, and the near-complete sample catches the loop returning toward its earlier construction state.
motion.motion_job: Make the construction relationship visible: flat component layers become a vertically expanded structure as the instructions progress.
motion.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

transferable_mechanism.reader_job: Understand how a multi-layer object is assembled, not merely read a list of assembly instructions.
transferable_mechanism.argument_shape: Construction sequence with an evolving spatial object.
transferable_mechanism.mechanism: Keep the instruction route persistent while the adjacent object changes its actual spatial state from components to assembled structure.
transferable_mechanism.use_condition: Use only when movement reveals a real construction, accumulation, containment, or transformation relationship and the final static still remains independently legible.

anti_copy_boundary: Do not reuse the source’s animated-funnel lesson, four instruction steps, stacked-cylinder geometry, nested ellipse styling, lavender title capsules, colour layers, or animation sequence.

claim_boundary.note: This is an instructional construction visual rather than performance evidence. Its matching workbook caption remains only an asserted numeric association.
